env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^quoted 1$'
stdout '^closer 1$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/sliceone56

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func Count[T any]() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n
}

func quoted() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{$"{ "(" }"})]byte }]()
}

func closer() int {
	return Count[struct{ N [len([1]string{$"{ ")" }"})]byte }]()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("quoted", quoted())
	fmt.Println("closer", closer())
}
